text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":50,"unit":"birds","kind":"count","span":"a total of 50 birds"},{"id":"q2","value":0,"unit":"birds","kind":"count","span":"he saw none"},{"id":"q3","value":120,"unit":"birds","kind":"count","span":"he saw 120 birds"},{"id":"q4","value":20,"unit":"birds","kind":"count","span":"day six he saw 20"},{"id":"q5","value":90,"unit":"birds","kind":"count","span":"day seven he saw 90"},{"id":"q6","value":7,"unit":"days","kind":"count","span":"day seven (the last of the seven days counted)"}],"plan":[{"op":"add","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"birds seen on days one through three"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"plus birds seen on days four and five"},{"op":"add","args":["s2","q4"],"out":"s3","note":"plus birds seen on day six"},{"op":"add","args":["s3","q5"],"out":"s4","note":"plus birds seen on day seven, the total birds for the week"},{"op":"div","args":["s4","q6"],"out":"s5","note":"total birds divided by number of days gives the daily average"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"the average number of birds Mack saw per day over the week"},"dismissed":[]}
